}}'''Nan Belman''' is a [[Darkfriend]] who resides in [[Caemlyn]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Nan Belman}} Her son is [[Perwyn Belman]].

== Appearance ==
She is handsome.

== Activities ==
[[Padan Fain]] comes to stay in her house to be near [[Rand al'Thor]]. Perwyn comes to Fain with the news of an attempted assassination on Rand's life. Fain takes her to her bedroom.{{ref/book|6|28}}
